title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch (deferred schema loading)
description: ToolSearch called 3 times to load deferred MCP tool schemas before implementation could begin. No moeb equivalent exists for loading deferred tool schemas in the Claude Code environment. Causes moeb-tool-origin to fail on every run.
proposed_resolution: Pre-include required tool schemas in start_run output, or introduce a schema-preload mechanism that eliminates ToolSearch calls during moeb runs.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used Bash to run cargo build --release and cargo test for binary-builds and all-tests-pass rubric verification. No moeb shell-execution tool exists.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a run_command moeb tool for shell execution within the tool boundary.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (large tool output)
description: start_run returned output exceeding inline limit; external Read used 5 times to read saved file. No moeb paginated-read tool exists.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a read_tool_result moeb tool for paginated access to saved large tool outputs.

title: Protected-skill guard condition deviates from spec code snippet
description: Spec Step 2 shows unconditional guard; implementation uses conditional check (also verifies local_path.exists()) to prevent kernel self-blocking. Spec raw requirement supports conditional approach but discrepancy creates ambiguity for future implementors.
proposed_resolution: Clarify Step 2 to show the conditional guard pattern, or introduce a separate kernel-internal loader that bypasses the project-override guard.
